Which tools best generate or refine a site design? Candidates: Google Stitch, v0, Lovable, Figma
(plus its AI / Make features), and image models such as Midjourney for visuals and mood boards.

Explore the "trainspotting"-inspired direction recorded in BRANDING.md.

**Timebox this.** It is an input to the visual design pass, not a project — the failure mode is
spending a week evaluating tools instead of a day designing. Worth doing precisely because the
alternative is designing by accident, but only worth a little.
